Music player · selected design review · Pixel 9 Pro Fold

Search A, with reachable folded-cover results

The user selected A (D51). On the unfolded panel, Search stays in the right pane and the bottom-left playback deck lifts above the keyboard. The folded cover has one full-width Search destination. The separate Results for “cam” heading is gone on both panels (D52); the query appears once in the Back/query/Clear header, with folder and track results directly beneath it.

Design only, with a real-keyboard finding. On a disposable Fold, real split Gboard on the inner panel and full-width Gboard on the cover let the user type “cam” with the complete deck and results visible in settled 100% and 200% states. Real floating Gboard obscured the unfolded playback title at 200% and both cover result labels at 100%. D53 accepts the unfolded deck overlap; D55 separately accepts the measured cover result-label overlap while the query stays visible. A real Gboard font-update banner on the disposable inner panel clipped the final mode until dismissed; D54 accepts that brief overlap. The complete deck remains required under ordinary settled docked and split keyboards. A remains the selected design. The keyboard-open review images use a separate 300dp debug input method, not Gboard. The indexed sanitized real-Gboard captures predate the retained-browser correction; a later disposable-device check confirmed its settled split keyboard with the browser header and full deck, but did not reproduce the transient banner. The Gboard evidence is indexed at package/music-player/design/evidence/gboard-geometry.md. No production implementation was made.

D56 adds keyboard-aware bottom space only to the folded-cover scrolling results viewport for ordinary docked/full-width keyboards; the header stays fixed. D57 separately accepts the observed inner real floating-Gboard overlap with some result lettering while the query stays clear. The inner layout is unchanged. Neither decision validates every IME height, animation frame, floating placement or result action.

Native source: unfolded 2076 × 2152 physical px (approximately 852 × 883dp) and cover 1080 × 2424px (approximately 443 × 994dp) at this AVD's 390dpi. Meaning-bearing app marks stay clear of the approximate physical crease at inner-panel x[983,1093); surfaces may cross it. E2 now sets an independent 7.5mm total opposing-information minimum even on a future narrower-crease device; a wider actual crease still governs. Status notification content is replaced with a generic clock.
